name: Hillsbrad Fields
summary: In Hillsbrad Fields, farmers and militia face constant attacks from nearby Tarren Mill. The settlement in western Hillsbrad Foothills is one of the few human communities in former Lordaeron to resist the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.

sections.title: A Defiant Bastion of Lordaeron
sections.body: Hillsbrad Fields stretch from Darrow Hill to the Azurelode Mine, where orchards, pumpkin patches, and pastures supply Southshore and the surviving Alliance resistance. The people endured while much of Lordaeron fell to undeath, keeping the royal tabard and heraldry of their fallen kingdom. Magistrate Burnside and the Council of Hillsbrad lead the township as an independent civic body under constant siege. Verringtan, the local blacksmith, and his apprentices arm the people, so farmers and laborers can defend their land.

sections.title: Front Line of the Undead Advance
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia and the Forsaken forces at Tarren Mill target Hillsbrad's fertile fields. The Undercity sees the thriving human settlement as a threat on its southern flank and directs constant raids against its crops, livestock, councilors, and farmers. Hillsbrad's defenders have formed a hardened militia in response. Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz organize ambushes and fight the undead to protect their homes.

faq.q: Why are there still living humans farming here?
faq.answer: Hillsbrad and neighbouring Southshore are among the few settlements in Lordaeron to avoid complete destruction by the Scourge during the Third War. Their people stayed to rebuild and maintain their homeland, while others fled south or joined the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: Who rules over the town and fields?
faq.answer: Magistrate Burnside governs the town and fields with Clerk Horrace Whitesteed and the Council of Hillsbrad from the town hall. Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz manage nearby estates, and Verringtan equips the town watch.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken attacking the farms?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia at Tarren Mill sees Hillsbrad as a dangerous Alliance foothold on the Forsaken border. Undercity orders direct soldiers to break human supply lines by destroying food stores, slaughtering livestock, and killing town leaders to clear the way for Forsaken dominance in the foothills.

faq.q: What happened to Hillsbrad during the Second War?
faq.answer: During the Second War, Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer ordered an assault on Hillsbrad to break human morale as the Horde built up its forces in the Southshore region. Hillsbrad was destroyed, but the Alliance drove out the orcs and the town was rebuilt.

angles.text: Hillsbrad Fields supply food and stand as a symbol of Lordaeron's enduring spirit. Protect them from the Forsaken's attacks.
High Executor Darthalia calls for Hillsbrad's farms and militia to be dismantled, securing the southern frontier for the Forsaken.
